parameters.content:
## CARD 1: 🚀 MASTER ORCHESTRATOR
Central coordinator for SIH-26100 bid verification.
Coordinates statutory, financial, forensic, and risk evaluations across distributed child agents.

## CARD 2: 📥 INPUT & VALIDATION
Receive and validate bidder verification requests.
Ensures request_id, bidder_name, and required_agents schema integrity before routing.

## CARD 3: 🧠 INTELLIGENT ROUTING
Determine which specialized verification workflows are required.
Deterministic orchestration mapping required agents into 8 execution branches.

## CARD 4: 🏛 STATUTORY
GST • PAN • Udyam • MCA • EPFO • ESIC • Startup India • NSIC • BIS • DPIIT • DigiLocker
Active specialized child workflows: 🧾 GST, 🪪 PAN, and 🏭 Udyam.

## CARD 5: 💰 FINANCIAL
Turnover • P&L • Balance Sheet • ITR • CA/UDIN
Validates financial threshold ratios, working capital, and net worth requirements.

## CARD 6: 🔍 DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE
Authenticity • OCR • Metadata • Signatures • QR
Analyzes bid submission PDFs for tampering, signature validity, and certificate seals.

## CARD 7: 🔗 ENTITY RESOLUTION
Cross-document legal entity consistency.
Reconciles bidder name, CIN, PAN, and address variations across all filings.

## CARD 8: ⚠️ RISK INTELLIGENCE
Blacklisting • Debarment • Risk scoring.
Evaluates debarment registers, adverse news, and calculates weighted risk scores.

## CARD 9: 🏆 FINAL DECISION
Compliance • Qualification • Risk • Evidence.
Synthesizes findings into QUALIFIED, NOT_QUALIFIED, or CONDITIONALLY_QUALIFIED.

## CARD 10: 🔄 RELIABILITY
Retry • Error handling • Fallback • Manual Review.
Configured with max 3 retry attempts (2000ms delay) and non-blocking failure fallbacks.
